title: The Divided Kingdom and Early Prophets
subtitle: 1 Kings 12-2 Kings 17, Amos, Hosea, Jonah, Micah
theme: The covenant fractures. God sends prophets to call his people back.
memoryText: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
reviewQuestions: What is Jeroboam’s sin, and why does it matter so much in Kings?
How do Elijah and Elisha function as types pointing forward to John the Baptist and Jesus?
What does Hosea’s marriage to Gomer reveal about God’s relationship to Israel?
What does Jonah teach us about the scope of God’s mercy?
psalmsNote: Laments and cries for justice (42 to 44, 58, 82, 94, 109, 74, 77) beside the prophets’ protests.
